title: Evidence OpenID4VP device-run receipt
description: One run of one wallet version against one evidence-oid4vp deployment, written by the device-run harness (crates/registry-evidence-oid4vp/tests/device_run.rs). It holds no claim value, token, nonce, session reference or request URI. A harness-written receipt has status draft; a person reviews it and sets status reviewed before committing it as products/evidence/fixtures/interoperability/oid4vp-device-run/<wallet>-<version>-<date>.json.

failingStage.description: Null on a pass. presentation-not-received: the wallet never posted before the timeout. verifier-rejected-presentation: evidence-oid4vp marked the session failed. evidence-refused: Evidence returned a dependency failure (see the verifier and Evidence logs). assertion-verification: the relying party could not verify the assertion. assertion-false: the assertion verified and said false. assertion-shape: the assertion held no single boolean output.
